extracted.name: Garlic Roasted Broccoli with Parmesan Cheese
extracted.description: Broccoli is roasted with garlic and olive oil, then tossed with lemon juice and shaved parmesan cheese.
ingredient_lines: 1 head broccoli, washed and cut into bite-sized pieces
4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, divided
0.25 cup Dietz & Watson Shaved Parmesan Cheese
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C).
Toss broccoli and garlic together on a large rimmed baking sheet; drizzle 3 tablespoons olive oil over top, then season with salt and black pepper.
Bake in the preheated oven until broccoli tender, 20 to 25 minutes.
Toss in Parmesan, lemon juice, and remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil; serve immediately.
